name: Mamiya Ayumu
source:
"Oh really? I didn't anticipate someone marching up and trying to tell me what to do."

A 17-year-old in Class 2-C.

The student council president who has the admiration of all the girls in the academy. He's careful in his interactions and comes off as aloof.

The only people he opens up to are his best friend Tokio and his younger sister, who he dotes on excessively.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
